title: Neocloud Stocks Rebound From Early Slide After Musk's 'Guppy-Level Death' Warning

tickers.name: CoreWeave, Inc. Class A Common Stock
Nebius Group N.V. Class A Ordinary Shares
Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Neocloud shares rebounded from a 5% to 6% morning slide on Monday, with TeraWulf rising 9.9%, Iren climbing 5.9% and CoreWeave gaining 5% after Elon Musk warned that more than 200 AI cloud operators face "guppy-level death and consolidation." Investor Dan Niles said the intraday reversal in CoreWeave, Nebius and Iren following an "unambiguously negative" catalyst could mark a short term bottom in the AI selloff after a 19% decline in the SOX index from Oct. 6 to Oct. 22, though he remains bearish on neoclouds over the long term.

Musk said on Sunday that debt markets have "almost entirely shut off access to money" for companies lacking substantial revenue outside AI data centers and predicted "a lot of stranded compute in partially complete data centers." By contrast, he confirmed SpaceX closed $40B in callable debt for GPU deliveries in the first half of 2027, supported by its investment grade credit rating and revenue from Starlink and rocket launches. In response to Musk's warning, TeraWulf's CEO said, "What others call stranded assets, we may call a development pipeline."

The warning follows tightening credit conditions across the sector, with Nebius CEO Arkady Volozh saying asset backed and debt markets had temporarily closed since the prior week, leaving the company to rely on customer advances and a $3.5B one year bridge loan from Citigroup. Balance sheets across AI cloud builders vary widely, with TeraWulf carrying $35.30 of debt per $1 of book equity ($5.21B of debt against $148M of equity as of June 30), compared with 9.9x at Cipher, 7.0x at CoreWeave and $0.83 per $1 of equity at Nebius.

selectedTweets.text:
The @elonmusk reply that “200+ neoclouds are going to see guppy-level death and consolidation” (I agree) caused neo-clouds to get hit again this morning for 5-6%. Now $CRWV $NBIS $IREN all up 4-7%. This clearing event might mark at least a short-term bottom in the AI selloff.

Short-term bottoms can never be known except in hindsight. But after a large decline already that has occurred over some time (this recent 19% decline in the SOX Index as a proxy for the AI names started back on 10/6 to 10/22), an event that is unambiguously negative like the post above, that initially leads to a large sell-off in the worst names in the sector (neo-clouds in my opinion) and that then reverses during the day is generally a good sign in my experience.

To be clear, I do not like the neo-clouds longer-term though they they may bounce the hardest short-term given they were some of the most oversold.  But this gives me more conviction that this is a potentially good time to put capital to work in the best positioned companies such as in the hyper-scalers, semis, power, construction, EPC, platforms etc.

Obviously poor earnings results from one of the big hyperscalers $MSFT $GOOGL $AMZN later this week could derail this but there is a lot of negativity priced in already.
